title: Logarithmic-space decidability of the initial language
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet, the language of paired encodings of an input word $x$ and two binary words for natural numbers $c,s$, where $c$ is the code of $N$'s initial configuration on $x$ with window parameter $s$, is decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
